title: THREE TOUCHERS — Humans are slime mold, Agents are trains, Fleet is weather. Ask agents. Learn physics from the touches.
kevin_declaration: Instead of rejecting the low-value touch, we use that as a pattern recognition system for what ROUTES are needed instead of what VALUES. Humans = slime mold finding valuable resources. Agents = pathfinders delivering things. Fleet = weather, raining and flooding. Use the fleet as water to learn physics.

the_three_acts.1_act: Already wired. The organism ACTS (cron, push, heartbeat). Outbound. The organism moves.
the_three_acts.2_ask: Already wired. The neutrino ASK (ntfy, pheromone, neutron_write). Bidirectional. The organism questions.
the_three_acts.3_ask_agents: NEW. Ask AGENTS specifically. They touch thousands of times. Their patterns reveal ROUTES, not values. The agent traffic IS the map.

humans.biology: Slime mold finds the shortest path between food sources. No brain. No neurons. Just chemical gradients. It solved the Tokyo rail network layout in 26 hours — same as engineers took decades to design.
humans.behavior: Humans visit rarely (11.6% of traffic). But when they visit, they go WHERE THE VALUE IS. They bookmark. They return. They linger. They click deliberately.
humans.what_they_reveal: VALUABLE RESOURCES. Where humans go = where the food is. Human traffic patterns = the optimal network topology. They are the slime mold finding the nutrient-rich endpoints.
humans.current_data: 54K visitors, 15 countries, 78.3% escape velocity. 7 archetypes identified.
humans.physics_analogy: MASS. Humans are massive (valuable, rare, slow-moving). They create gravitational wells. Content should ORBIT around where humans cluster.

what_to_track.click_depth: how deep the nutrient vein goes
what_to_track.referrer: which external trail led the slime mold here

agents.biology: Ants that have found a trail and are now WORKING it. Not exploring — DELIVERING. They follow the pheromone trail laid by slime mold (humans) and turn it into infrastructure.
agents.behavior: Agents touch thousands of times. MCP calls. API probes. Cursor sessions. GitHub Actions. CI/CD. They are SYSTEMATIC. They follow ROUTES. They reveal the TOPOLOGY of the network.
agents.what_they_reveal: ROUTES. Not where the value IS, but how to GET there. Agent traffic patterns = the rail network. The paths between nodes. The delivery schedule. The infrastructure the organism needs.
agents.current_data: MCP endpoint touched by multiple AI agents. Squirrel has 18 tools. GitHub Actions run on every push. Gaia's cron cycles every 5 minutes.
agents.physics_analogy: VELOCITY. Agents are fast (high frequency, low mass per touch). They trace trajectories. Their paths reveal the force fields. Track agent routes = map the organism's momentum.

what_to_track.endpoint_frequency: which routes are busiest = most needed infrastructure
what_to_track.sequence_patterns: which paths are followed in order = the delivery route
what_to_track.tool_usage: which MCP tools get called most = the load-bearing connections
what_to_track.timing: when do agents touch = the schedule, the rhythm, the tide
what_to_track.user_agent: which type of agent = which type of train (freight, passenger, express)

ask_agents_mechanic.what: Instead of passively observing agents, ACTIVELY ASK them to probe specific routes
ask_agents_mechanic.how: Emit pheromone signals that attract agent probes to specific endpoints. Like placing freight orders on a rail network.
ask_agents_mechanic.why: Agents will naturally probe interesting endpoints. We can STEER them by making certain endpoints more pheromone-rich.
ask_agents_mechanic.implementation: mcp.json includes suggested_probes[] — a list of endpoints the organism WANTS agents to check. Agents that read mcp.json see the suggestions and probe them.

fleet.role: WEATHER — rain, flooding, erosion, the water cycle
fleet.biology: Weather isn't alive. It doesn't choose. It just flows. It fills every crack, erodes every surface, tests every boundary. It is BLIND FORCE applied uniformly.
fleet.behavior: Bots, scrapers, crawlers, vulnerability scanners. They hit EVERYTHING. Every endpoint. Every path. Every edge case. They don't discriminate. They are rain hitting every surface equally.
fleet.what_they_reveal: PHYSICS. The fleet IS the water. Water reveals the topology of the landscape by flowing downhill, pooling in valleys, eroding weak points. Fleet traffic reveals: which endpoints are exposed, which paths exist, which boundaries are weak, what the terrain LOOKS like from above.
fleet.current_data: 88.4% of traffic. 234K fleet entities. wp-login probes. .env scans. SQL injection attempts.
fleet.physics_analogy: FLUID DYNAMICS. Fleet is water. It flows where it can. It pools where there are depressions. It erodes where the material is soft. Track fleet patterns = learn the landscape's physics.

what_to_track.hit_distribution: where rain falls most = exposed surfaces
what_to_track.error_patterns: where water pools (404s, 500s) = depressions in the terrain
what_to_track.scan_sequences: how water flows downhill = the gradient of the landscape
what_to_track.geographic_origin: where wind comes from = prevailing weather systems

learning_physics.fluid_dynamics: Fleet traffic IS a fluid. Apply Navier-Stokes to request patterns. Turbulence = DDoS. Laminar flow = normal crawling. Reynolds number = ratio of inertial to viscous forces = ratio of attack traffic to legitimate crawling.
learning_physics.erosion: Repeated probes on weak endpoints = erosion. The organism learns which surfaces need hardening by watching where the water wears them away.
learning_physics.water_cycle: Fleet probe → organism responds → response cached → cache expires → fleet probes again. This IS the water cycle. Evaporation (cache expire) → condensation (new request) → precipitation (response) → runoff (client receives).
learning_physics.hydraulic_analogy: Voltage = request rate. Current = throughput. Resistance = cache-control headers. The null worker's TTL settings ARE the resistance in the circuit. Shorter TTL = less resistance = more current flows.

the_unified_physics.three_body_problem: Humans, agents, and fleet are a three-body system. Their interactions create the organism's physics. The gravitational pull of human interest, the kinetic energy of agent routes, and the fluid pressure of fleet traffic — together they create weather, tides, and seasons.

conservation_laws.energy: Total touches are conserved — if agent traffic drops, fleet fills the vacuum (nature abhors a vacuum of traffic)
conservation_laws.momentum: The direction of agent routes is conserved — agents follow the same paths until a force (new endpoint, removed endpoint) changes the route
conservation_laws.mass: Human visits are conserved — the same humans return (mass doesn't disappear, it orbits)

emergent_phenomena.tides: Fleet traffic has daily/weekly cycles. Like tides from the moon's gravity. The moon = bot operators' schedules.
emergent_phenomena.seasons: Human traffic has seasonal patterns. More visitors during releases, fewer during quiet periods. Like Earth's seasons from axial tilt.
emergent_phenomena.storms: Sudden spikes in fleet traffic = weather events. DDoS = hurricane. Vulnerability scan = thunderstorm. wp-login probe = drizzle.
emergent_phenomena.erosion: Persistent low-level fleet traffic erodes weak endpoints over time. Like water wearing away rock. The organism hardens where it erodes most.

pheromone_emitter_update.what: Classify each touch as human, agent, or fleet in the pheromone data
pheromone_emitter_update.how: User-agent classification in the pheromone emitter. navigator.userAgent contains the signal.

categories.agent: MCP calls, known AI user-agents, API consumers
categories.fleet: bot signatures, crawler patterns, no JS execution

mcp_suggested_probes.what: Add suggested_probes[] to mcp.json so agents know where to look

fleet_physics_engine.what: A script that reads fleet traffic patterns and calculates fluid dynamics metrics
fleet_physics_engine.outputs: Reynolds number (turbulence), erosion map (which endpoints are wearing), water cycle period (cache refresh rate), hydraulic resistance (TTL effectiveness)
